Thanks all — below are concise answers we can send to Medivance. I attached a redacted SOC2 report and a sample JSONL export (small slice).

Short answers (for Emma/Carlos):
1) Immutability: Hosted API customers: we retain activity logs for 90 days by default and provide exports on request (export API / support-assisted S3 push). Hosted exports can be placed into customer-owned S3; however, object lock (WORM) requires the destination S3 bucket to be configured for Object Lock — that is controlled by the customer. For legally-enforceable immutability backed by our platform, Dedicated and Private deployments support enforced WORM policies via customer-managed object storage (Recommended for customers requiring strict legal immutability).

2) Export format & fidelity: Exports are JSONL, one event per line. Guaranteed fields in admin activity records: timestamp (ISO8601), actor (internal user id/email), action (string), target (resource id), request_id (uuid), ip_address, outcome (success/failure), metadata (map). Full request/response bodies are NOT included by default; bodies containing user-submitted content are redacted unless the customer requests full-body capture and accepts the ingestion/retention tradeoffs.

3) Delivery options: 
- Support-assisted S3 push (recommended) — we push a compressed JSONL bundle to a customer bucket.
- API pull (engineering-to-engineering) — programmatic export available for scheduled pulls.
- DB-level extracts for Private/Dedicated customers under a service engagement.

4) Encryption & key management: All exported objects are encrypted in transit and at rest. For Hosted exports to a customer S3, server-side encryption with customer KMS keys (SSE-KMS) is supported; for Dedicated/Private, customers can bring their own keys and HSM integrations are available. We can provide a signing header (SHA256) for each export bundle on request.

5) SOC2 & timeline: Attached is a redacted SOC 2 Type II (2025) summary plus a redacted report. We can deliver the redaction + questionnaire answers today.
